description: The root of an email template: subject/preheader metadata, global Styles and the ordered list of Sections. This is the canonical editable model that the generator turns into MJML and the importer produces from MJML.

members.name: CreatedAt
members.description: Gets or sets the creation timestamp (UTC).

members.name: Id
members.description: Gets or sets the unique identifier of this document.

members.name: Language
members.description: Gets or sets the language code (defaults to Czech, "cs").

members.name: Name
members.description: Gets or sets the human-readable template name.

members.name: Preheader
members.description: Gets or sets the preview text shown in inboxes (mj-preview).

members.name: Sections
members.description: Gets the ordered sections that make up the body.

members.name: Styles
members.description: Gets or sets the global styles and head settings.

members.name: Subject
members.description: Gets or sets the email subject line (mj-title / mail subject).

members.name: UpdatedAt
members.description: Gets or sets the last update timestamp (UTC), when known.
